P0 front room (parts/room-1.mjs) no longer writes the smoker at 7,3,12 that the Hearths part already placed; its layout is now table, two chairs, barrel dresser, poppy and candle.
Off-palette was already empty for this part; the only fix was the refused write.
make.sh runs to completion and writes build.nbt; this part reports 8 placed, 0 refused, 0 off-palette.
left: The same refusal remains in room: P1 east flat (smoker at 19,3,12) and room: P3 front room (smoker at 40,3,12); those are in room-3/room-7-era modules that this fix did not touch, per the instruction to edit only parts/room-1.mjs.

waste.what: Finding which earlier part owned the refused cell (7,3,12) meant grepping the parts and reading parts-report.json by hand, then guessing the fix from the message alone.
waste.cost: about 4 tool calls, one failed Edit from a text mismatch, and a second rebuild to confirm
waste.tool: make.sh / runParts should print the owning part name for each refused cell (e.g. 'smoker at 7,3,12 already placed by Hearths') and the offPalette list inline, not only in parts-report.json.

waste.what: Deciding which cells of a layers() legend collide with earlier parts meant reading the layer rows by hand to drop the S entry.
waste.cost: one legend entry and one row edited by hand, plus a comment rewrite
waste.tool: layers() could take an option to skip cells already occupied in the grid (like a no-overwrite mode), or runParts could list the collision cells of a layers() call so the designer can see them before writing.

companions.task: Confirm the Hearths smoker at 7,3,12 is set to face west into the front room, since this part no longer places it and the room depends on that facing.
